test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language. 'JAMB' is written as 'SBPA' and 'BOAT' is written as 'ANBI'. How will 'JERK' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**'JAMB' is written as 'SBPA',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38bfe78406f7e38d3d315c4a4d08c58990a4021d7807b595af348a9fba6d1179.png] 

**'BOAT' is written as 'ANBI',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3832512e118559dc12037376f25e951e0e355d6871b6c75ebf637e988b205454.png] 

Similarly,

**'JERK' can be coded as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0728b42a0279c060de2fe336c8d226423c68334b4e92c89e3bc24a3a32ed40ab.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SXKR"**.
